deliverables: Cardano hardware-wallet maintenance and compatibility assurance
Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
Transparent capped time-and-materials reporting and milestone-based disbursement controls
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor
request.what: Fund 12 months of Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, including Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, interoperability libraries, cardano-hw-cli, developer support, integration support, and vendor-required audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests a total of 1,310,960 ADA, consisting of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Cardano hardware-wallet support requires continuous maintenance because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk.

The scope is limited to compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work, and does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.
The proposal states that users retain secure signing and builders avoid broken integrations when hardware-wallet flows remain maintained.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

Funding would be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified admin, leadership, and external oversight sign-off thresholds.

The Oversight Committee is stated to consist of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with a role limited to verifying key administrative actions using on-chain logic rather than exercising governance discretion.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is provided for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ADA and related smart-contract metrics.

summary: The document presents a 1,310,960 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect for 2026 hardware-wallet maintenance, with a detailed budget split, governance process references, smart-contract administration details, and several externally checkable references, while many technical necessity and non-duplication claims remain proposer assertions.
